# GEOGRAPHY linestrings
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions
#
# BigQuery adds the midpoint of an edge of 165.89 degrees and not of one of 100: the length from
# which it does, along the equator and off it.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 110 0)')
?> "LINESTRING(0 0, 110 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 120 0)')
?> "LINESTRING(0 0, 120 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 130 0)')
?> "LINESTRING(0 0, 130 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 140 0)')
?> "LINESTRING(0 0, 70 0, 140 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 150 0)')
?> "LINESTRING(0 0, 75 0, 150 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 160 0)')
?> "LINESTRING(0 0, 80 0, 160 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 165 0)')
?> "LINESTRING(0 0, 82.5 0, 165 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 10, 120 10)')
?> "LINESTRING(0 10, 120 10)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 -60, 0 60)')
?> "LINESTRING(0 -60, 0 60)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 -80, 0 80)')
?> "LINESTRING(0 -80, 0 0, 0 80)"

# Whether a split edge's halves are split again.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 179 0)')
?> "LINESTRING(0 0, 89.5000000000001 0, 179 0)"

SELECT ST_NUMPOINTS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 179 0)'))
?> "3"
